SITE ALPHA
DR. JONATHAN FELLOWS

Compositional structure remains indeterminate. Samples are unreadable beneath microscopic examination. Surface refracts light in a manner inconsistent with known mineral or organic matter.

Material resists nearly every chemical agent introduced. Acids, solvents, and reactive compounds yield no discernible reaction.

Standard classification methods have failed to produce comparative data within any known elements. I am prepared to consider that we may be observing an element or compound not yet documented by modern science. Its behavior suggests a classification outside presently accepted frameworks. Its properties defy all precedent within the current scientific record.
